critical_code_review_comments: Budget.jsx is now ~520 lines and mixes 5 distinct concerns (data, calc presentation, EditableCell, SiteCell, HiddenIndicator, drag-select, context menu, keyboard nav). Consider splitting EditableCell, HiddenIndicator, SiteCell, and the column-selection/keyboard-nav hooks into separate files for readability and reuse — file is approaching the 700-line threshold for refactor and DRY.

shouldFocus in EditableCell uses useEffect on [shouldFocus] only; if the same cell receives shouldFocus=true twice in a row, the second activation won't fire. In practice keyboard nav clears focusCell to null between hops which is OK, but consider tracking a focus token (e.g., monotonic id) to be robust against repeated focus to same key.

advanceFocus iterates COLUMNS for the same row across rowIdx + 1...; if all remaining rows have no editable cells (e.g., locked margem in venda mode + every other field already filled), it silently sets focusCell to null. Consider giving the user a visual hint or wrapping back to the same row.

EditableCell uses input type='number' for currency/percent — this strips R$/% during edit AND on some locales the user cannot type a comma decimal separator. Verify pt-BR users can input '2,5' for percent fields or normalize to '.' before commit.
Hidden columns persist to localStorage key 'erp_hidden' globally (not per bid). Different bids share the same hide preset which may surprise users.

Drag-select uses document mouseup listener but does not handle pointer leaving the table; if the user releases over a different element type (e.g., outside body), it should still cleanup — current handler does via document listener, OK.
calc.js: margem_real and markup share the same value; the duplicate field is fine but slightly confusing — a comment could clarify why both keys exist (legacy consumer compat?).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two important selector traps when editing cells via -view click pattern: valor_venda uses testid 'erp-venda-{rid}' (not 'erp-valor_venda-{rid}') and margem uses 'erp-margem-{rid}'. Helper that commits via Enter MUST then press Escape to close the auto-opened next cell, otherwise the next edit_cell call will fail (next cell is in <input> mode, not -view). For navigation, after pressing Enter/Tab inside an input, document.activeElement is the freshly-opened next input; the previous cell's -view div will only re-appear after a commit + Escape. Calculated columns (calc_currency/calc_pct) and SELECIONAR (Checkbox) and SITE (custom SiteCell) are skipped by advanceFocus. The two CSS classes to look for to detect selected columns are arbitrary-value Tailwind: !bg-[#E8F0FE] (header AND td) — easiest detection is outerHTML.includes('E8F0FE'). The negative bg arbitrary class is bg-[#FCE8E6] with text color #D93025 (computed: rgb(252,232,230) bg / rgb(217,48,37) text).
